paragraphs.text: translated by
1. STABLISHED for thee, to lend thee vital forces, Giver of wealth, Guard of his servant's body.
paragraphs.original: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्वा सीददपामुपस्थे ।
paragraphs.translit: pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadvā sīdadapāmupasthe |

paragraphs.text: The Great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, Abider with men, is seated in the lap of waters.
paragraphs.original: दधिर्यो धायि स ते वयांसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः
paragraphs.translit: dadhiryo dhāyi sa te vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Worshipping, seeking him with adoration like some lost creature followed by its footprints,
paragraphs.original: इमं विधन्तो अपां सधस्थे पशुं न नष्टं पदैरनु ग्मन् ।
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ vidhanto apāṃ sadhasthe paśuṃ na naṣṭaṃ padairanu gman |

paragraphs.text: Wise Bhrgus, yearning in their hearts, pursued him, and found him lurking where the floods are gathered.
paragraphs.original: गुहा चतन्तमुशिजो नमोभिरिच्छन्तो धीरा भृगवोऽविन्दन्
paragraphs.translit: guhā catantamuśijo namobhiricchanto dhīrā bhṛgavo'vindan

paragraphs.text: 3. On the Cow's forehead, with laborious searching, Trita, the offspring of Vibhiavas, found him.
paragraphs.original: इमं त्रितो भूर्यविन्ददिच्छन्वैभूवसो मूर्धन्यघ्न्यायाः ।
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ trito bhūryavindadicchanvaibhūvaso mūrdhanyaghnyāyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Born in our houses, Youthful, joy-bestower, he now becomes the central point of brightness.
paragraphs.original: स शेवृधो जात आ हर्म्येषु नाभिर्युवा भवति रोचनस्य
paragraphs.translit: sa śevṛdho jāta ā harmyeṣu nābhiryuvā bhavati rocanasya

paragraphs.text: 4. Yearning, with homage, they have set and made him blithe Priest among mankind, oblation-bearer,
paragraphs.original: मन्द्रं होतारमुशिजो नमोभिः प्राञ्चं यज्ञं नेतारमध्वराणाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mandraṃ hotāramuśijo namobhiḥ prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ netāramadhvarāṇām |

paragraphs.text: Leader of rites and Purifier, envoy of men, as sacrifice that still advances.
paragraphs.original: विशामकृण्वन्नरतिं पावकं हव्यवाहं दधतो मानुषेषु
paragraphs.translit: viśāmakṛṇvannaratiṃ pāvakaṃ havyavāhaṃ dadhato mānuṣeṣu

paragraphs.text: 5. The foolish brought the ne'er-bewildered forward, great, Victor, Song-inspirer, Fort-destroyer.
paragraphs.original: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरा अमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् ।
paragraphs.translit: pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrā amūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam |

paragraphs.text: Leading the Youth gold-bearded, like a courser gleaming with wealth, they turned their hymn to profit.
paragraphs.original: नयन्तो गर्भं वनां धियं धुर्हिरिश्मश्रुं नार्वाणं धनर्चम्
paragraphs.translit: nayanto garbhaṃ vanāṃ dhiyaṃ dhurhiriśmaśruṃ nārvāṇaṃ dhanarcam

paragraphs.text: 6. Holding his station firmly in the houses, Trita sat down within his home surrounded
paragraphs.original: नि पस्त्यासु त्रित स्तभूयन्परिवीतो योनौ सीददन्तः ।
paragraphs.translit: ni pastyāsu trita stabhūyanparivīto yonau sīdadantaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thence, as Law bids, departs the Tribes' Companion having collected men with no compulsion.
paragraphs.original: अतः संगृभ्या विशां दमूना विधर्मणायन्त्रैरीयते नॄन्
paragraphs.translit: ataḥ saṃgṛbhyā viśāṃ damūnā vidharmaṇāyantrairīyate nṝn

paragraphs.text: 7. His are the fires, eternal, purifying, that make the houses move, whose smoke is shining,
paragraphs.original: अस्याजरासो दमामरित्रा अर्चद्धूमासो अग्नयः पावकाः ।
paragraphs.translit: asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ |

paragraphs.text: White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and sitting in the wood; like winds are Somas.
paragraphs.original: श्वितीचयः श्वात्रासो भुरण्यवो वनर्षदो वायवो न सोमाः
paragraphs.translit: śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. The tongue of Agni bears away the praise song, and, through his care for Earth, her operations.
paragraphs.original: प्र जिह्वया भरते वेपो अग्निः प्र वयुनानि चेतसा पृथिव्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra jihvayā bharate vepo agniḥ pra vayunāni cetasā pṛthivyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Him, bright and radiant, living men have stablished as their blithe Priest, the Chief of Sacrificers.
paragraphs.original: तमायवः शुचयन्तं पावकं मन्द्रं होतारं दधिरे यजिष्ठम्
paragraphs.translit: tamāyavaḥ śucayantaṃ pāvakaṃ mandraṃ hotāraṃ dadhire yajiṣṭham

paragraphs.text: 9. That Agni, him whom Heaven and Earth engendered, the Waters. Tvastar, and with might, the Bhrgus,
paragraphs.original: द्यावा यमग्निं पृथिवी जनिष्टामापस्त्वष्टा भृगवो यं सहोभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: dyāvā yamagniṃ pṛthivī janiṣṭāmāpastvaṣṭā bhṛgavo yaṃ sahobhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Him Matarisvan and the Gods have fashioned holy for man and first to be entreated.
paragraphs.original: ईळेन्यं प्रथमं मातरिश्वा देवास्ततक्षुर्मनवे यजत्रम्
paragraphs.translit: īḷenyaṃ prathamaṃ mātariśvā devāstatakṣurmanave yajatram

paragraphs.text: 10. Agni, whom Gods have made oblation bearer, and much-desiring men regard as holy,
paragraphs.original: यं त्वा देवा दधिरे हव्यवाहं पुरुस्पृहो मानुषासो यजत्रम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvā devā dadhire havyavāhaṃ puruspṛho mānuṣāso yajatram |

paragraphs.text: Give life to him who lauds thee when he worships, and then shall glorious men in troops adore thee.
paragraphs.original: स यामन्नग्ने स्तुवते वयो धाः प्र देवयन्यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः
paragraphs.translit: sa yāmannagne stuvate vayo dhāḥ pra devayanyaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ
